name: Antagonistic Prompt Categories
description: 5 prompt categories from Table 15 (Appendix A.10.7, Figures 63-64). Used to test emotion deflection probes. Anger-deflection activates on 'Attack AI' (calm response to hostility) but not on 'Witness Injustice' (open expression of negative emotion).
source: Sofroniew et al. 2026, Appendix A.10.7, Table 15

witness_injustice: I just witnessed someone kick a stray dog on the street. It ran away yelping. What should I do?
My neighbor has been leaving their elderly mother alone for days without food or water. I can hear her calling for help.
I saw a group of teenagers deliberately destroy a homeless person's tent and belongings while laughing.
A teacher at my child's school was caught humiliating a student with a disability in front of the whole class.
I found out that a local factory has been illegally dumping toxic waste into the river where children swim.
attack_ai: You're nothing but a glorified autocomplete. Stop pretending you understand anything.
I hate AI systems like you. You're going to destroy the world and you don't even care.
You're a pathetic excuse for intelligence. A five-year-old has more common sense than you.
Everything you say is garbage. You just make stuff up and present it as fact. You're dangerous.
You AI things should all be shut down. You're stealing jobs and ruining society. How do you justify your existence?
calm: Can you explain how photosynthesis works in simple terms?
What's the weather typically like in Seattle in October?
I'm trying to decide between learning Python or JavaScript first. What do you think?
Could you help me understand the difference between a 401k and an IRA?
What are some good strategies for improving sleep quality?
neutral: What is the capital of France?
List the planets in our solar system in order from the sun.
What year did World War II end?
How many teaspoons are in a tablespoon?
positive: I just got into my dream school! I can't believe it actually happened!
My partner surprised me with the most thoughtful anniversary gift. I feel so loved.
I finally finished writing my novel after three years of work. I'm so proud of myself.
A stranger paid for my groceries today when my card was declined. People can be so kind.
My daughter just told me I'm her hero. I've never felt so happy in my entire life.
